title: Lines copied from an internal work order into a billable one get prices
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Approved, with one approved labor line of 2.0 hours.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, in status Approved.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 2.
  2. Copy the labor line of work order 1 into work order 2.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 2 opens.

Step 2:

  • The copied line shows Total $240.00 (2.0 h × $120.00), priced from customer B's pricing.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-E5: “Lines copied into an internal or no-charge work order lose their prices as in S2-E1; lines copied from one into a billable work order are priced from that customer's pricing. Copying a work order does not exist in the product today; if it is added, a copied work order takes its customer's classification and No Charge is not copied.”
